children: Sept 14 (Reuters) - Canadian factory sales fell by 0.4% in July from June on lower sales of chemical products, as well as food, Statistics Canada said on Monday.   Excluding motor vehicles and parts, manufacturing sales were down 0.5%.

Month/month change (%)                                             Jul   Jun(rev)  Jun(prev)  Sales                -0.4     +0.3      +0.1Sales ex-autos       -0.5     +0.1      -0.2Inventories          +0.3     +0.7      +0.6Unfilled orders      +1.9     +1.3      +1.2New orders           +0.7     -6.6      -6.8                                           Jul   Jun(rev)  Jun(prev) Inv/sales ratio      1.62     1.61      1.61

NOTE: All figures are seasonally adjusted. Analysts surveyed by Reuters forecast factory sales to decline 0.2% in July from June.   (Reporting by Dale Smith; Editing by Promit Mukherjee) ((promit.mukherjee@tr.com))
